text: {"lessons":["The account’s decline after its early gains reminds me that short-term results are uncertain; I should judge choices against my long-term goals, not a few monthly moves.","Because losses hurt me more than gains please me, I should avoid letting loss aversion or the pain of selling at a loss dictate whether I hold or sell.","Selling Stock D at a profit felt good, but future trades should follow a deliberate plan for diversification and risk rather than the satisfaction of locking in gains."]}
